about_the_game:
Dreaded Conquest is a real-time strategy game of grand-scale control, where you lead sinister forces to spread your influence across a procedurally-generated world. Use your units and skills to conquer cities and crush mortal forces. It is set in a dark fantasy world with pixel art graphics.

Key features:

  • Grand-scale control: Command your dark armies across an entire world map. Focus on global strategy without micromanagement of units.

  • Procedural worlds: Each map is different, with its own challenges and opportunities to plan your strategy!

  • Dynamic events: Face unpredictable events that adapt to your progression to keep every game fresh and challenging. 

  • Different types of gameplay: Choose between three powerful dark lords, each with unique units, skills, and research trees that shape your strategy.

  • Varied units: Deploy a wide range of creatures, each with distinct strengths, abilities, and roles in your army.

  • City conquest: Capture cities to automatically generate new units and expand your dominion.

  • Research and progression: Unlock upgrades and new units to orient your gameplay.

  • Skills: Personally intervene in battle with devastating abilities that can turn the tide of battle.

  • Difficulties: Choose your pace; play calmly to watch your empire rise, or face intense resistance for a true challenge.
